fastText language identification

lid.176.ftz is the unchanged compressed language-identification model published
by Facebook's fastText project. It is licensed under Creative Commons
Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported (CC BY-SA 3.0), not MIT or GPL.
License: LICENSE-model.txt
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
Model information and attribution:
https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/language-identification.html
Original download:
https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/fasttext/supervised-models/lid.176.ftz
The model was trained on Wikipedia, Tatoeba and SETimes data.

Authors and publications credited by the fastText project:
Armand Joulin, Edouard Grave, Piotr Bojanowski and Tomas Mikolov.
Bag of Tricks for Efficient Text Classification (2016).
https://arxiv.org/abs/1607.01759
Armand Joulin, Edouard Grave, Piotr Bojanowski, Matthijs Douze, Herve Jegou
and Tomas Mikolov. FastText.zip: Compressing text classification models (2016).
https://arxiv.org/abs/1612.03651

fasttext.js and fasttext.wasm contain the fastText runtime, distributed under
MIT. Copyright (c) 2016-present, Facebook, Inc.
License: LICENSE-fasttext.txt
https://github.com/facebookresearch/fastText

Runtime binaries originate from fasttext.wasm 1.0.1 by DreamOfIce, under MIT.
License: LICENSE-wasm-wrapper.txt (original copyright notice retained)
https://github.com/DreamOfIce/fastText.wasm
https://registry.npmjs.org/fasttext.wasm/-/fasttext.wasm-1.0.1.tgz
The package builds the upstream fastText core with Emscripten. Emscripten and
runtime component notices are retained in LICENSE-emscripten.txt,
LICENSE-musl.txt, LICENSE-libcxx.txt and LICENSE-compiler-rt.txt.

Changes to the runtime loader: converted fasttext.mjs to a classic worker
script by replacing import.meta.url with self.location.href, removing the
ES module export, and disabling Node.js environment detection. The generated
Embind invoker was replaced with the synchronous DYNAMIC_EXECUTION=0 path
from Emscripten 3.1.45 so it does not require JavaScript string evaluation:
https://github.com/emscripten-core/emscripten/blob/3.1.45/src/embind/embind_shared.js
Copyright 2012 The Emscripten Authors; see LICENSE-emscripten.txt.
The WASM binary and model are unmodified. No upstream TypeScript wrapper is
included.

Each component retains its own license. The application's GPLv3 license does
not replace these licenses. Preserve these notices when redistributing.
